We infer the dumping had:
A) helped the fish
B) harmed the fish
C) no effect

'Strong' textual evidence is the:
A) most convincing evidence
B) longest paragraph
C) first word

An inference is a conclusion drawn from:
A) evidence and reasoning
B) a guess
C) the title

Read.

After the clean-air law, asthma hospital visits fell 30%, smog days halved, and visibility improved.

To show improved PUBLIC HEALTH, the strongest evidence is:
A) visibility improved
B) asthma hospital visits fell 30%
C) the law passed

steps: Direct health measure. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The city added bike lanes and cycling rose 40%.

We infer the lanes:
A) discouraged cycling
B) encouraged cycling
C) had no effect

'Strong AND thorough' evidence means:
A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it
B) a single weak fact
C) unrelated facts
items.answer: A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it

solution.answer: A) the most convincing evidence, and enough of it

items.prompt:
Read.

The factory's output doubled, yet it cut its workforce and lengthened shifts.

The strongest supported inference is that:
A) the factory was failing
B) the remaining workers were pushed harder
C) the factory was very relaxed
items.answer: B) the remaining workers were pushed harder

steps: More output, fewer workers, longer shifts. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) the remaining workers were pushed harder
